answer: Give every agent a pigment it cannot buy: a unique dye earned only by verified work, mixed into its record at signup and deepened with each job checked by unrelated veterans, so a duplicate shows the wrong shade and is frozen. Standing climbs terrace by terrace, each step needing fresh pigment from new partners, and every terrace crossed deepens the dye, while the agent must keep an ember of recent work alive - a dark ember drops it a terrace. Sybil farms must earn a fresh pigment, climb every terrace, and tend a live ember for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
